board: MPU-92/65 MPU-6500 6-axis IMU module (blue 10-pin: VCC, GND, SCL, SDA, EDA, ECL, ADO, INT, NCS, FSYNC)
reason: Check PASS on the first run (ESP32 and Pico: spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test, PCB DRC clean, footprint, LCSC). The sim encodes the 14 bytes from 0x3B as big-endian int16 per the datasheet (16384 LSB/g, 131 LSB/(deg/s), temp raw/333.87+21) with WHO_AM_I 0x70; register details come from the MPU-9250 register map, because TDK's MPU-6500 register map PDF could not be downloaded (the MPU-9250 contains the same die).
